channel.title: Official EVO Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Official EVO Magazine (evo.co.uk)

item.title: BMW USA leaks M2 xDrive and M350 top-spec 3-series
item.description: A slip-up by BMW USA’s parts site has confirmed the imminent arrival of a number of new models

item.title: Peugeot wants to build perfect GTi hot hatches, but with one major caveat
item.description: Peugeot CEO Alain Pavey outlines his intentions for the GTi brand. For him the cars have to be nothing short of perfect

item.title: BMW M2 CS gets M Performance track kit, including a wild wing
item.description: BMW’s track kit for the M2 CS adds wild aero to the hardcore coupe

item.title: Save £24,000 on a new BMW M4 Competition – massive discounts on M’s flagship coupe
item.description: If you've thought about buying BMW's M4 coupe now might be the time. Current discounts make them as cheap as an M2

item.title: Range Rover Sport SV Ultimate is a throwback to the old supercharged SVR
item.description: The Range Rover Sport SV was intended to be more grown-up and capable than the brash old SVR it replaced. This new edition gives the bygone blunderbus a nod

item.title: GMA T.50s testing concludes with 184mph flat-out lap of Bahrain F1 circuit
item.description: GMA’s 761bhp V12 track-only hypercar is now finished and in production, with the 25 examples set to be delivered before the end of 2026

item.title: New Cupra Born arrives as a feistier Volkswagen ID.3, with bucket seats and up to 322bhp
item.description: Cupra has given the ID.3-based Born a substantial refresh, comprising a new design, updated interior and physical steering wheel controls rather than haptics

item.title: New Maserati GranTurismo spied testing – Italy’s underdog Aston Martin rival sharpens up
item.description: The Maserati GranTurismo is getting a mid-life refresh for 2026. Expect a nip and a tuck rather than revolutionary changes

item.title: Lotus ditches all-electric plans, launches 939bhp Eletre X-hybrid
item.description: Lotus has confirmed its new electrified X-hybrid powertrain will debut in 939bhp Lotus Eletre X

item.title: Mercedes-AMG GT 4-Door interior reveals new secrets about AMG's Porsche Taycan rival
item.description: The covers are slipping off Mercedes-AMG’s hotly anticipated electric flagship. The interior’s been revealed first, with a number of key details on show.
